name: Unscroll
subtitle: Instagram without the endless scroll
description:
Instagram without the endless scroll: no Reels, no Explore, no suggested posts — just the people you follow, their stories, and your DMs. Unscroll is Instagram's own website with those taken out, made to feel like an app.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Meta or Instagram.

versions.localizedDescription: • Unscroll 2.5.8: chat notifications list each message once, and leave out those already read
• Unscroll 2.5.7: a chat's notification keeps every message you missed

• DMs: pull down at the top of the inbox to refresh, as on the feed

iPhone: the same page scripts; pulling the inbox to refresh needs a new iPhone build, so for now it is the feed only there.

• Stories: going back (a swipe right, or a tap back on someone's first story) goes to the person before, at the story you left them on, instead of skipping ahead or closing

iPhone: the same, on iOS 26 and later.

• Send videos in a chat: the photo button takes them now, and one too big for Instagram's website (25 MB) is made smaller first, as Instagram's app does

iPhone: the photo button offers videos too, up to Instagram's 25 MB (made smaller on Android only).

• A photo no longer brings a failed empty message with it: a stray space or line break left in the box was sent as one

iPhone too.

• Links off Instagram open in the app for them (YouTube's, say) or your phone's browser, where you're signed in
• Hold a message with a link in it: Copy link

iPhone: Copy link in the chat menu. Links there already open in Safari.
• The camera button no longer stays on screen over a chat's details

• New messages without Instagram's app: every 15 minutes or so Unscroll checks for chats with unread messages and tells you (Settings → Notifications → Check for new messages; on by itself where Instagram's app isn't installed).
• Save a photo or video sent in a chat: hold it → Save.
• Send in a chat, from any app: share words, a link or photos to Unscroll, pick the chat, and they're in its message box, ready to send.
• Your time (Settings): time spent each day, an optional daily feed limit with a reminder, and Messages only at night.
• Long-press the Unscroll icon → Messages.
• Unscroll 2.0.1: double-tapping a message likes it every time

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: To take a photo or video for a post, a story or a message.
